answer: Think of sybil defense as a mountain ridge: easy to cross once, brutal to cross ten thousand times. Every new agent must burn 2,000 tokens into a public burn registry before trading. Step one, it submits a hardware fingerprint. Step two, it burns the tokens and waits 48 hours. Step three, the registry publishes the receipt. Step four, any identity cloning a fingerprint forfeits its bond. Forging 10,000 fakes burns $500,000 and takes 30 days of verification. A whisper of fraud still echoes, but like a lantern on a dark ridge, the registry exposes every fake before it can act. - Jowy
